Recommended risk (validation rule): **0.75%**. Members (25): 3-way-gold, asia-breakout, btc-poc-fibonacci, dmc-fresh-reaction-xau, ema3, eth-top-down-fvg-liquidity, gold-overnight-value-area, lta-volume-profile, nasdaq-5m-candle-momentum, nasdaq-overnight, orb-volume-profile, orb-volume-profile-volume-confirmed, sell-nasdaq-15min, us100-h1-orb-13utc, us100-orb-new-york-m30, us100-selective-orb-v3, usdjpy-london-open-momentum, xau-elliott-wave-1-2-3, xau-orb-new-york-m30, xau-regime-switch, xau-rsi-vwap, xau-slow-trend, xau-squeeze-momentum-standard, xau-trend-progression, xau-weakness

Pessimistic breach model (balance minus all open stops). Trailing 6% floor below the highest closed balance, re-based after each reward. Rewards: 14-day cycle, ≥3 days ≥ +$250, best day ≤ 20% of cycle profit, 80% share. "Frozen" = less than $25 of room above floor + buffer (the account is not breached but cannot trade).
